claim_ceiling: Reproduction specification for one published Vicsek cluster topology/geometry study and a separately labelled OLI periodic-geometry extension; not evidence of biological life or intelligence

publication.title: Topology and geometry of clusters in the Vicsek model across scales

erratum.title: Erratum: Topology and geometry of clusters in the Vicsek model across scales
erratum.correction: The neighbour set for heading at t+dt is measured at t+dt, while the neighbour headings/velocities averaged are from t.
erratum.interpretation: Corrected equation is indistinguishable from the forward-update implementation; backward-update results have different cluster scaling.

implementation_mapping.next_position_alignment: Algorithmically equivalent to inspected author forward-update C++ file and erratum-corrected neighbour-time convention.
implementation_mapping.current_position_alignment: OLI current-position comparator; exact source backward code has not yet been pinned.

author_repository.rights_rule: No source code or data are copied or redistributed. Repository files are referenced by URL and Git blob SHA only.

update_rule_reference.forward_source_semantics: Move positions using headings at t; build neighbour cells from predicted positions at t+dt; choose neighbours at predicted positions; average their headings at t; add angular noise; retain predicted positions.
update_rule_reference.noise_parameterization: source scalar nu maps to full angular noise interval 2*pi*nu radians
update_rule_reference.source_rng: std::mt19937 seeded from std::random_device; no exposed deterministic seed in inspected forward template
update_rule_reference.parity_boundary: Algorithmic rule and strict interaction predicate pinned; exact random trajectories and float32 bit patterns are not expected to match.

rasterized_disk_union.raster_rule: Stamp integer pixel offsets within radius in pixel units around every agent; area is unique stamped pixel count * pixel_size^2.
rasterized_disk_union.interpretation: Dilated point-set union area; not an alpha-shape area.

cluster_filter.interpretation: Legacy coordinate-edge filter, not a torus-aware exclusion rule.

point_partition.leaf_points: points for which inShape is false

degree_partition.distance_rule: Euclidean dx,dy; both absolute coordinate differences <= 1; Euclidean distance <= 1; exclude self distance 0
degree_partition.caveat: This source boundary degree calculation is not periodic at the box seam and must be reproduced separately from the OLI torus-aware extension.

largest_cluster_shape_extraction.selection: Largest connected component passing min_x >= 1 and min_y >= 1 in the inspected code; this is not the same as retaining every component.
largest_cluster_shape_extraction.output: cluster size, mean degree, centroid, display box size, agent coordinates and graph edges
largest_cluster_shape_extraction.caveat: Legacy filter and display box selection must not be mistaken for a torus-aware geometric definition.

source_aggregation.bin_midpoints: geometric mean of adjacent log-spaced edges
aggregation_order: Within each source file and mass bin, calculate means of geometry and degree metrics over clusters.
Across files, calculate the mean and population standard deviation of those file-level means.
source_aggregation.count_semantics: Total clusters accumulated in each mass bin across source files.
source_aggregation.uncertainty_caveat: The exported standard deviation is across per-file means, not a cluster-level standard error or a seed-level confidence interval. Preserve file/trajectory hierarchy in independent reanalysis.

inspected_forward_template_parameters.noise_values: template placeholder; exact run-script values not yet pinned

source_reproduction.additional_observed_source_context: Author README describes 9 density-speed pairs; update-rule comparison outputs include N=32768 post-processed datasets. The exact run configuration and critical-noise grid still need recovery.

sibling_update_rule_sources.requirement: Pin exact sibling file blobs and reproduce the erratum-corrected/forward and backward variants separately.

oli_extension.label: PERIODIC_MULTISCALE_CLUSTER_GEOMETRY
oli_extension.distinction_from_source: New OLI geometry and topology metrics must be reported beside, never substituted for, source-legacy results.
design_requirements: Periodic seam-aware connected components and unwrapped component coordinates.
Distinct metrics for point-set area, disk-dilated area and alpha-shape area/perimeter.
Periodic-aware concave hull or alpha-shape implementation with explicit alpha/mesh/pixel sensitivity.
Interaction-radius filtration and H0 component merge/persistence profile.
Per-cluster degree, mean path length, clustering, area, perimeter, mass and orientation; avoid only system-wide averages.
Finite-size scaling and uncertainty estimated over independent seeds/trajectories, not frames or clusters.
Translation, rotation and box-seam invariance controls.
Separate update-rule strata; no pooling of forward/corrected and backward results.

proposed_qualification_targets.source_profile_reproduction: Within a pre-registered tolerance on source summary outputs after recovering exact parameter grids, update rule, sampling schedule and source outputs.
proposed_qualification_targets.periodic_seam_invariance: No change beyond numeric tolerance when a system is translated across the periodic boundary.
proposed_qualification_targets.geometry_convergence: Publish area/perimeter convergence curves as pixel or mesh resolution changes.
proposed_qualification_targets.scaling_model_selection: Compare power-law, polylogarithmic and alternative scaling models with uncertainty; do not select a model by visual straightness alone.
